policy_description: Framework for credit assessment, risk rating, monitoring, and escalation of credit facilities
Criteria and process for escalation of matters from business/credit to internal legal and external counsel
Minimum requirements for security documentation, registration, and perfection for secured lending
Guidelines for recovery actions, enforcement of security, and engagement of external recovery counsel
Framework for employee requests for medical, maternity-related and other protected or company-approved leave; Legal review required where statutory treatment is uncertain
Requirements for attendance, absence notification, manager escalation and documented attendance interventions
Employees are expected to provide accurate and authentic information and documentation; suspected irregularities must be verified before misconduct conclusions are reached
Framework for factual investigation, employee response, evidence assessment, proportionality and Legal review before material disciplinary action
Standards for structured performance improvement plans, objective measurement and documentation of outcomes
